topic: Analyzing session data for dwell time
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging and comparing two SQL queries designed to retrieve device session aggregation data, specifically looking for 'dwell time' metrics at a particular facility. The initial query suggested the presence of dwell time, while a second, more detailed query did not show it.

[me] identified that the discrepancy was likely due to variations in `facility_master_num`. [me] explained that sessions from that day were not yet updated with the master number, and committed to adjusting the process so this manual update would no longer be necessary. The issue was resolved after a brief follow-up discussion.
decisions: The data retrieval method will be adjusted to pull `facility_master_num` directly from `facility_dict` when `param_forceLatestMasterNum = 1`.
